transport.authorization: Bearer admin session; actor and permission rechecked for every request
transport.queryRules: Unknown and repeated query keys are rejected; limit is 1..100, default 25; ownerId and deviceId must be non-nil UUIDs.

pagination.ordering: Stable descending timestamp plus UUID/type tie breakers; cursor is exclusive.
pagination.consistency: Live pagination; no cross-request snapshot guarantee.

item.ackSeq: nonnegative safe JSON integer (0..9007199254740991) or null when device epoch is stale
item.headSeq: nonnegative safe JSON integer (0..9007199254740991) or null when device epoch is stale
item.lag: nonnegative safe JSON integer (0..9007199254740991) or null when device epoch is stale

nullSemantics.lastSuccessAt: unsupported: sync_devices persists last_seen_at but no last-success timestamp
nullSemantics.lastErrorCode: unsupported: no durable per-device sync error record exists
nullSemantics.epochMismatch: ackSeq, headSeq, and lag are null when deviceEpoch differs from activeEpoch

unsupportedFilters: requestId: no durable sync request diagnostic index exists

item.state: QUEUED | CAPTURING | VERIFYING | READY | FAILED | RUNNING | COMPLETED | BLOCKED | CANCELLED
item.capturedSeq: nonnegative safe JSON integer or null
item.storedBytes: nonnegative safe JSON integer or null
item.plainBytes: nonnegative safe JSON integer or null

GET /admin/v1/backups.nullSemantics: Size, capture sequence, schema, and error are null until a persistent source has a value; unknown failure strings map to null. protectedUntil is unsupported because no separate protection timestamp is stored.

itemFields.expectedHeadSeq: nonnegative safe JSON integer; omitted from support projection

itemFields.attempts: nonnegative safe JSON integer; recurrence is schema-bounded to 0..8
itemFields.durationSeconds: completed latest recurrence attempt duration as a nonnegative safe JSON integer, or null when not persisted
itemFields.actionVersion: positive integer for SNAPSHOT; null for RECURRENCE. The database trigger increments it when state, attempts, lease, failure, backup lifecycle, protection, or object identity changes.

POST /admin/v1/jobs/{id}/retry.supported: SNAPSHOT only; FAILED, unexpired, non-protected jobs with an allowlisted retryable failure and no lease reset to QUEUED; MANUAL/DAILY jobs are eligible only before an object is published.

POST /admin/v1/jobs/{id}/cancel.supported: SNAPSHOT only; never-claimed QUEUED jobs become terminal CANCELLED.

actions.receipt: Encrypted session and roleVersion scoped replay receipt binds route, job ID, operation ID, expectedVersion, and reason. Mutation, receipt, and audit commit atomically.
actions.audit: Projects action, reason, state and actionVersion only; excludes snapshot contents and credentials.

item.snapshotStoredBytes: exact nonnegative safe JSON integer sum of sync_snapshot_jobs.stored_bytes for READY snapshot jobs, or null when none; snapshot bytes are reported separately from attachment object metrics
item.attachmentStoredBytes: exact nonnegative safe JSON integer sum of bytes for non-DELETED storage_objects, or null when none; excludes sync_snapshot_jobs stored_bytes
item.attachmentObjectCount: nonnegative safe JSON integer count of non-DELETED storage_objects
item.unreferencedObjectCount: nonnegative safe JSON integer count of non-DELETED storage_objects with no attachment_references through attachments
item.pendingGcCount: nonnegative safe JSON integer count of non-DELETED storage_objects in GC_PENDING or GC_DELETING, or with a persisted attachment_gc_leases row

GET /admin/v1/storage-summary.scope: Snapshot metrics aggregate sync_snapshot_jobs only. Attachment byte and object metrics aggregate non-DELETED storage_objects only; attachment_references/attachment_gc_leases refine their counts. Snapshot object_id references and snapshot stored_bytes are not joined or added to attachment metrics. Unreferenced means no attachment_references row for an attachment backed by the object; pending GC is a distinct object count, not lease attempt count.
GET /admin/v1/storage-summary.integerPrecision: Every emitted integer is checked to be a nonnegative JavaScript safe integer (0..9007199254740991) before JSON projection. If a persisted value or count exceeds this range, the endpoint returns the existing AUTH_UNAVAILABLE error; it never emits a rounded Number.
GET /admin/v1/storage-summary.overflow: PostgreSQL SUM(bigint) is explicitly cast to BIGINT. A sum outside signed BIGINT range raises numeric_value_out_of_range and maps to AUTH_UNAVAILABLE; a sum within BIGINT but above the JavaScript safe-integer range is rejected by the projection check with AUTH_UNAVAILABLE. Values are never clamped or rounded.

security.errorCodes: Only known application-owned enums are returned; all other values become null.
security.authorization: Each route validates the actor session and the route-specific permission before data access.
